description: Selected source-based corrections; the canonical master, character map and OpenType features are preserved.

H.notes: Trace the 1892 patent alphabet; suppress scan-edge stair steps and retain only the main ink component. Preserve the original advance and rounded visible outline bounds. See source/METHOD.md.

J.notes: Trace the 60-point J in Jaunts, MSJ 1892 p. 274; use the larger impression for a continuous stem and round curl. Preserve the original advance and rounded visible outline bounds. See source/METHOD.md.

L.notes: Trace the 1892 patent alphabet; suppress scan-edge stair steps and retain only the main ink component. Discard isolated scan marks; the L target bounds exclude the stray triangle below its foot. Preserve the original advance and rounded visible outline bounds. See source/METHOD.md.
